about: House bumpers: Adult Swim-style station IDs that air in the station breaks between programs. Text cards only, in the app's own style — no video. Picked from the clock (web/js/bumpers.js), so every TV in the same break shows the same bumper. On Commercial Break (CH 14) every break is a house ad; elsewhere about one break in three. Edit freely: kicker is the small line on top, title is the big line, sub is the line under it.
